fixturePreparation: setup-config-r1.mjs created, through the Administrator API, the Contract type DOC-029 inbox Supplier agreement (with Priya Raman as its default person), the Matter type DOC-029 inbox Advisory, two request types targeting them, five global Fields (carried text, request-only text, required text on the destination types only, an Entity reference, and a Region select), two Entities, and two Matter templates. The Advisory template sets a TPL - title prefix, Low default Priority, Critical default Risk, Supplier name and Region defaults, a Matter Manager Task at +3 days, an unassigned Task without a due offset and a checkpoint Key date at +5 days. The Stale template default Region West was saved while the option existed; the option was then removed. Identifiers are in fixtures-r1.json.

setup-requests-r1.mjs signed Jonas Weber in with a fresh magic link and submitted sixteen fictional Requests, R-106 to R-121, through the Portal API with generated PDF and Word attachments; then it archived DOC-029 inbox Old Holdings Ltd, which the two main conversion Requests per role carry. Numbers are in requests-r1.json.

Earlier development runs of the same script on R-23 to R-38 and R-80 to R-103 fixed harness locators (Status card id, Portal Comments control label, Document version route, record tab link names, the Old Holdings restore before resubmission). Those runs left decided DOC-029 inbox Requests and records in this disposable shared lab. Their logs are not part of this record and no result here comes from them.

Competing resolutions and conversions were written by the other legal role through the lab API while the browser write was held with a Playwright route. The people-load failure used an aborted browser request, and the failed save used a controlled 503 browser response. Everything else ran in the browser.
observations: No resolution email for R-107 (Administrator run) reached Jonas in the lab Mailpit, while R-115, the race Requests R-108 and R-116, and earlier development resolutions each produced "Your request is resolved: R-n". The guide says the note can be emailed subject to notification preferences and delivery, so this is recorded, not failed.
